modal.title: Register New Patient
modal.name: Full Name
modal.description: Fill in the basic details. The chart can be completed later.
modal.nameHint: As shown on the identity document.
modal.birthDateHint: Type numbers only: day, month and year.
modal.documentHint: Only the 11 digits; punctuation is added automatically.
modal.phoneHint: Include the area code. Mobile numbers have 9 digits.

details.loadError: Unable to load the clinical record. Check that the patient exists or try again.
details.selectEncounterDesc: Please select or register an encounter in the "Encounters" tab.

allergiesCard.title: Immunological Allergies & Intolerances (AllergyIntolerance)
allergiesCard.empty: No allergies or intolerances registered for this patient

conditionsCard.title: Active Diagnoses & Comorbidities (Conditions - FHIR)
conditionsCard.empty: No active diagnoses registered for this patient

medicationsCard.title: Prescriptions (MedicationRequest - FHIR)

reportsCard.title: Clinical Reports & Conclusions (DiagnosticReport)
reportsCard.empty: No reports attached to this encounter

allergy.title: Register Allergy
allergy.description: Record a confirmed allergy or intolerance for the patient.
allergy.displayHint: Allergen or allergy name, as it will appear in the chart.
allergy.reactionHint: What the patient experiences and how severe. E.g. severe hives.

condition.title: Register Comorbity
condition.displayPlaceholder: e.g. Essential hypertension, Type 2 diabetes mellitus
condition.description: Record a diagnosis or comorbidity for the patient.
condition.codeHint: A letter followed by numbers. E.g. I10 or E11.9.
condition.displayHint: Diagnosis name, as it will appear in the chart.

encounter.title: Register New Encounter
encounter.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Routine cardiology consultation, Annual check-up
encounter.description: Open a new encounter for this patient.
encounter.reasonHint: Main reason for the visit, in a few words.
encounter.practitionerHint: Doctor who will conduct the visit.

medication.title: Prescribe Medication
medication.name: Medication / Drug Name
medication.dosagePlaceholder: e.g. Take 1 tablet orally every 8 hours for 7 days
medication.nameHint: Medication name with strength. E.g. Amoxicillin 500 mg.
medication.dosageHint: Dose, route, frequency and duration of the treatment.

observation.title: Register Vital Signs
observation.description: Fill in only what was measured. Enter at least one value.

report.title: Register Clinical Report
report.examPlaceholder: e.g. Complete Blood Count, Chest X-Ray PA
report.conclusionPlaceholder: Describe clinical conclusions and observations for the exam...
report.description: Record the result of an exam from this encounter.
report.examTypeHint: Choosing the type fills in the exam name for you.
report.examHint: Exam name as it will appear in the report.
report.conclusionHint: Result and clinical interpretation of the exam.

reportVersions.title: Report Version History
reportVersions.empty: No versions recorded for this report.
reportVersions.noConclusion: No conclusion recorded in this version.

reportDetails.title: Report Details
reportDetails.noConclusion: No conclusion recorded for this report.

medicationSafety.title: Safety check
medicationSafety.blockedByServer: Prescription blocked: the patient has an active allergy. A justification is required.

checkFailed.title: Safety could not be verified
checkFailed.description: The allergy and interaction check failed. Retry, or prescribe without verification at your own responsibility.

messages.generic: Safety alert for {{medication}}. Review before prescribing.

allergy.activeIngredient: The patient has an active allergy to {{allergen}}, an ingredient of {{medication}}.
allergy.sameClass: The patient is allergic to {{allergen}}, which may cross-react with {{medication}} (class {{drugClass}}).

interaction.moderate: {{medication}} has a moderate interaction with another active medication ({{drugClass}}).
interaction.major: {{medication}} has a major interaction with another active medication ({{drugClass}}).
interaction.contraindicated: {{medication}} is contraindicated with another active medication ({{drugClass}}).

override.title: Override required
override.description: This prescription is blocked by a safety alert. Doctors can override it with a justification, which is recorded in the audit log.
override.serverBlocked: The server blocked this prescription because of an active allergy. Provide a justification to override.
override.justificationPlaceholder: Explain why the benefit outweighs the risk (min. 10 characters)
override.notPermitted: Your role is not permitted to override safety blocks. Ask a doctor to review this prescription.
